name: Taruki Distillery
description: Taruki Distillery is an artisanal WordPress theme crafted for independent distilleries, tasting rooms, and craft beverage workshops. Rooted in calm, editorial typography and warm documentary imagery, it features an unhurried process timeline, transparent price ledgers, and direct visit booking. Two flat colour strips over a charcoal navigation row, a photograph flush left beside the headline with a six-dot batch timeline, a sticky still photograph beside six ruled process chapters, an inset still-room photograph with stage dots and a frosted botanicals photograph. DM Serif Display for headings, Work Sans for reading. Works without WooCommerce.

summary.en: A craft gin distillery: stacked colour strips over a charcoal nav, a split hero with a batch timeline, a sticky six-stage process, an inset still-room photo and a price ledger.
